description: Since Python 3.14 (PEP 649/749) annotations are compiled into `__annotate__` and evaluated on first access, so forward references need no quotes.
`VALUE` evaluates (and raises on undefined names), `FORWARDREF` substitutes `ForwardRef` placeholders, `STRING` returns source text.
A placeholder for a name that could not be resolved yet; `@dataclass` in 3.14 can keep one in `field.type`.
PEP 563: stores every annotation as a string. Still supported in 3.14; deprecation planned after 3.13 reaches end of life.
A schema field is required when it has no default; it may still accept `null` when its type is `T | None`.
